decisions.quote: Although we replicated the association of rs613872 with FECD in our dataset, we failed to replicate the association with rs10490775 in PTPRG .
decisions.reason: The study deliberately tested two associations from Baratz et al. (2010)—rs613872 in TCF4 and rs10490775 in PTPRG—and explicitly frames the results as replicating the first while failing to replicate the second, which requires coding the outcome as mixed under the codebook rules.
